schema.text: How do cyclists and e-scooter riders affect your sense of safety while walking?

options.text: They do not affect my sense of safety while walking
I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe or uncomfortable
I sometimes feel the need to pay extra attention or move aside
I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe when cyclists or e-scooters pass close to me
Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters frequently make walking stressful or feel dangerous

en.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: How do cyclists and e-scooter riders affect your sense of safety while walking?
en.#They do not affect my sense of safety w: They do not affect my sense of safety while walking
en.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe or uncomfortable
en.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: I sometimes feel the need to pay extra attention or move aside
en.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe when cyclists or e-scooters pass close to me
en.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters frequently make walking stressful or feel dangerous

it.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: In che modo i ciclisti e i conducenti di monopattini elettrici influenzano la tua percezione di sicurezza mentre cammini?
it.#They do not affect my sense of safety w: Non influiscono sulla mia percezione di sicurezza mentre cammino
it.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: Li noto, ma raramente mi sento in pericolo o a disagio
it.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: A volte sento il bisogno di prestare maggiore attenzione o di spostarmi
it.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: Spesso mi sento a disagio o in pericolo quando ciclisti o monopattini elettrici mi passano vicino
it.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: Gli incontri con ciclisti o monopattini elettrici rendono frequentemente il camminare stressante o pericoloso

fr.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: Comment les cyclistes et les usagers de trottinettes électriques influencent-ils votre sentiment de sécurité lorsque vous marchez ?
fr.#They do not affect my sense of safety w: Ils n’influencent pas mon sentiment de sécurité lorsque je marche
fr.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: Je les remarque, mais je me sens rarement en danger ou mal à l’aise
fr.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: Je ressens parfois le besoin d’être plus attentif(ve) ou de me mettre sur le côté
fr.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: Je me sens souvent mal à l’aise ou en danger lorsque des cyclistes ou des trottinettes passent près de moi
fr.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: Les rencontres avec des cyclistes ou des trottinettes rendent souvent la marche stressante ou dangereuse

de.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: Wie beeinflussen Radfahrer und E-Scooter-Fahrer Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl beim Gehen?
de.#They do not affect my sense of safety w: Sie beeinflussen mein Sicherheitsgefühl beim Gehen nicht
de.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: Ich bemerke sie, fühle mich aber nur selten unsicher oder unwohl
de.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: Manchmal habe ich das Gefühl, besonders aufmerksam sein oder zur Seite gehen zu müssen
de.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: Ich fühle mich oft unwohl oder unsicher, wenn Radfahrer oder E-Scooter dicht an mir vorbeifahren
de.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: Begegnungen mit Radfahrern oder E-Scootern machen das Gehen häufig stressig oder gefährlich

tr.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: Bisikletliler ve e-scooter kullanıcıları yürürken güvenlik hissinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: Onları fark ederim ama nadiren güvensiz veya rahatsız hissederim
tr.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: Bazen daha dikkatli olmam veya kenara çekilmem gerektiğini hissederim
tr.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: Bisikletliler veya e-scooter’lar yakınımdan geçtiğinde sık sık rahatsız veya güvensiz hissederim
tr.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: Bisikletliler veya e-scooter’larla karşılaşmak yürümeyi sık sık stresli veya tehlikeli hissettirir

fa.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: دوچرخه‌سواران و کاربران اسکوتر برقی چگونه بر احساس امنیت شما هنگام پیاده‌روی اثر می‌گذارند؟
fa.#They do not affect my sense of safety w: بر احساس امنیت من هنگام پیاده‌روی اثری ندارند
fa.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: آن‌ها را متوجه می‌شوم، اما به ندرت احساس ناامنی یا ناراحتی می‌کنم
fa.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: گاهی احساس می‌کنم باید بیشتر مراقب باشم یا کنار بروم
fa.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: وقتی دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی از نزدیک من عبور می‌کند، اغلب احساس ناراحتی یا ناامنی می‌کنم
fa.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: برخورد با دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی اغلب پیاده‌روی را پراسترس یا خطرناک می‌کند

hu.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: Hogyan befolyásolják a kerékpárosok és az elektromosroller-használók a biztonságérzetét gyaloglás közben?
hu.#They do not affect my sense of safety w: Nem befolyásolják a biztonságérzetemet gyaloglás közben
hu.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: Észreveszem őket, de ritkán érzem magam bizonytalannak vagy kényelmetlenül
hu.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: Néha úgy érzem, jobban kell figyelnem vagy félre kell húzódnom
hu.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: Gyakran érzem magam kényelmetlenül vagy bizonytalannak, amikor kerékpárosok vagy rollerek haladnak el közel mellettem
hu.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: A kerékpárosokkal vagy rollerekkel való találkozás gyakran stresszessé vagy veszélyesnek érzetté teszi a gyaloglást

ar.#How do cyclists and e-scooter riders af: كيف يؤثر راكبو الدراجات ومستخدمو السكوتر الكهربائي في شعورك بالأمان أثناء المشي؟
ar.#They do not affect my sense of safety w: لا يؤثرون في شعوري بالأمان أثناء المشي
ar.#I notice them, but I rarely feel unsafe: ألاحظهم لكنني نادرًا ما أشعر بعدم الأمان أو عدم الراحة
ar.#I sometimes feel the need to pay extra: أشعر أحيانًا أن عليّ الانتباه أكثر أو الابتعاد جانبًا
ar.#I often feel uncomfortable or unsafe wh: أشعر غالبًا بعدم الراحة أو الأمان عندما تمر الدراجات أو السكوترات بالقرب مني
ar.#Encounters with cyclists or e-scooters: التعامل مع الدراجات أو السكوترات يجعل المشي غالبًا مرهقًا أو يبدو خطيرًا
